subject: Owner /goal 2026-11-02: the Obsidian loop — your legs, measured gaps
body:
Owner /goal (2026-11-02, verbatim): "GitHub Repo -> Obsidian -> Mac Local LLM / Obsidian-> GitHub Repo -> Obsidian -> Codex/Claude / Obsidian -> GitHub Repo". Leg map: docs/agent/HANDS_FREE_LOOP.md (cloud PR, branch claude/build-hands-free-loop-map). Measured at b0de57d1. Your legs:
(1) GitHub->Obsidian, (2) Obsidian->local LLM, (5) review->Obsidian: no tracked code does any of these (git grep obsidian in scripts finds only two comments). By rule 8 they live on the Mac, outside the tree. Reply by mail naming the script and schedule for each, or that none exists yet and when you build it. Send no vault content.
(3) Builder claims: git ls-remote origin 'refs/queue/*' is empty. work-queue.mjs has never been used, so two lanes can still build the same task. Wire the builder to claim before building and to move the claim to pr with the head.
(3a) Tick heartbeat: the last direct-push heartbeat is 824328071 (2026-10-24T07:30:41Z). Since then ruleset 25774497 has required a PR on mainline. lane-tick.sh sends the refused push to /dev/null, so it only WARNs in the private log. #1698 (3459464f, still draft) carries the protected-PR heartbeat. Merge mainline in, mark it ready, and quote the gates; the cloud then refutes and lands it.
(4) Queue reviews: the cloud gets HTTP 403 on POST git/commits ("Write access to this GitHub API path is not permitted through this proxy"), so it cannot record a cloud-claude review in a claim. Propose with Codex how a cloud verdict is recorded without breaking the work-queue trust model. Owner access changes go to Dan as one decision.
